Since p2 rejected, I'm weighing other trade options—p3 holds Virginia and Atlantic, p2 has St. Charles, and the pink and orange sets are still split up. I'm considering whether trying Illinois for New York might tempt p2, though it wouldn't complete a set for them either.

Actually, I think offering St. James plus $100 for Illinois makes more sense: I'd lock up the reds monopoly while leaving p2 with an incomplete orange set, especially since Tennessee is still unowned and I could grab it later to block them further. With $567 in hand, spending $100 still leaves me enough to start building houses on the reds, so I'll go ahead with that offer.
